integrity: The universal statement has an unrestricted written algebraic and valuation proof. Finite standard-library checks are supplementary and cannot certify the infinite assertion. Originality comparisons were made against identified published works; no independent audit was performed.
limitations: Exact formula is confined to cubes of classical Pell numbers. It does not settle generalized Lucas recurrences, cubic associated Pell windows, or higher exponents. An equivalent result in unindexed literature is possible.
title: Exact cubic-window GCDs of Pell numbers
